sanskrit_verse:
आहुत्याप्यायते सूर्यः सूर्याद् वृष्टिर् अथौषधिः ।
तदन्नं रसरूपेण शुक्रत्वम् अधिगच्छति ॥३.७१॥
transliteration: āhutyāpyāyate sūryaḥ sūryād vṛṣṭir athauṣadhiḥ | tadannaṃ rasarūpeṇa śukratvam adhigacchati || 3.71||
sph_interpretive_translation: By oblation, the Sun is nourished; from the Sun proceeds rain, and from rain, herbs. That food, in the form of essence, attains purity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from sacrificial offering, not arbitrary power.
Causation follows a sequential divine order: sacrifice → solar energy → precipitation → vegetation → purified sustenance.
Capacity-based responsibility lies in maintaining alignment with cosmic sacrifice.
Restoration logic operates through participation in the cycle of offering and receiving.
Consciousness alignment occurs when actions reflect understanding of interdependence.
executable_legal_axioms: IF action disrupts sacrificial flow THEN realign through restorative offering.
IF entity consumes without contributing to sacrificial cycle THEN initiate capacity-renewal protocol.
IF resource degradation detected THEN trace causal chain back to disruption in offering-based reciprocity.
IF societal imbalance observed THEN evaluate adherence to sequential dharma of sustenance.
IF individual disconnected from source THEN engage completion process via ritual reconnection.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating environmental or economic disputes, the Court must assess whether parties have fulfilled their reciprocal obligations within the sacrificial cycle. Disruption at any level—individual, corporate, or state—must be addressed by restoring alignment with the causal sequence originating in conscious offering.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that all existence depends on sequential manifestation rooted in offering. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that misalignment manifests progressively as scarcity or decay. Responsibility is proportional to one's position in the sacrificial chain. Justice is enacted not through penalty but through restoration of the offering-consciousness relationship.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate ahuti-based purification for entities causing systemic disruption.
Reconnect individuals to source through guided ritual participation.
Implement community-wide sacrificial renewal where collective imbalance is found.
Assign completion processes involving direct contribution to ecological or social regeneration.
Restore capacity through supervised reintegration into the cycle of mutual nourishment.
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through recognition of the sacrificial continuum. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All beings are called to align with the eternal rhythm of offering and fulfillment.
